name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Income support of ₹6,000/year paid directly to eligible farmer families in three installments.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
description: Subsidized crop insurance covering yield losses from natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Low-interest short-term credit for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and farm asset maintenance.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil testing and nutrient recommendations to improve fertilizer efficiency and crop yield.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Irrigation)
description: Subsidies for micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) equipment to improve water-use efficiency.

name: UP Ganna Kisan Yojana (Sugarcane)
description: State-specific support and price assurance for sugarcane growers in Uttar Pradesh.
